name: COD order confirmation
script: Hi {{customer_name}}, this is {{store_name}}. You placed order {{order_name}} for {{order_total}} with cash on delivery. Press 1 to confirm or 2 to cancel.

name: Abandoned cart recovery
script: Hi {{customer_name}}, you left some items in your cart at {{store_name}}. Press 1 and we'll text you a link to finish your order.

name: Delivery reminder
script: Hi {{customer_name}}, your order {{order_name}} from {{store_name}} is out for delivery today. Please keep {{order_total}} ready. Press 1 to confirm you're available.
